title: Z-fighting

Recorded facts — Artifact: Z-fighting; Cause: depth precision limits; Fix: offset polygons or increase near/far ratio. Used by graphics engineers, technical artists, and QA teams shipping real-time and offline renderers.

print("WITHIN TOLERANCE" if ratio <= max_ratio else "INVESTIGATE")
